### Configuration

Register the theme source path by adding the following line to the `layout.css` file:

```css
@source "../node_modules/@sjsf/skeleton5-theme/dist";
```

## Extra widgets

You can connect extra widgets using the following `include` imports:

:::note

For a widget to be applied, it must be explicitly specified in the
[UI schema](/form/ui-schema/#ui-components)
or used in the field as the default widget.

:::

<Code lang="ts" code={createExtraImports("skeleton5", extraWidgets)} />
